meta.reliability_rule: Land size and value per m² use only rows that are full-title (no sectional units, whose extent is the unit floor area, and no farms, whose extents were never validated), valued at R10,000 or more, with an extent between 20 m² and 50,000 m², from a roll whose extents agreed with the Surveyor-General cadastre (match.db roll_unit: unreliable=0 and at least 30 tested erven).
meta.freehold_residential: 8-group 'residential', tenure not sectional, value above R1,000.
meta.percentile_method: nearest-rank: the first value whose row number is at least p x n, over rows valued above R0.
caveats: Dates of valuation differ between municipalities (from 1 Jul 2020 to 1 Sep 2025, plus Laingsburg's 2018 draft), so comparisons between municipalities compare different years.

City of Cape Town lists each multi-use property twice: a HOLDING or MULTIPLE PURPOSES parent row with an erf, and per-use ALLOCATION rows without one (about R36bn, 1.4% of the provincial total). Headline totals, percentiles, histograms, groups and concentration include both. Place rankings exclude both kinds of row; findings exclude the allocation rows.
Sectional-title units count as properties. How many a roll records varies (Cape Town 26% of rows, several rolls none), so sectional shares are not comparable.
Supplementary rolls are included for only 9 municipalities; the others are general-roll snapshots.
Categories are normalised into 8 groups by an ordered keyword rule; about 1.5% of rows (1.7% of value) stay uncoded and count as 'other'.
Seven rolls have no vacant-land category, so vacant land there is counted as residential or other.
Land size and value per m² cover only rows that pass the extent reliability rule; farm and sectional extents are never used.
Value per m² is the whole property's value (land and buildings) divided by the land area; it is not a land price.
R0 rows (cross-references, sectional scheme parents) and rows without a value are counted as properties but excluded from every value statistic.

Place labels are the roll's suburb or township names (Cape Town uses Surveyor-General township names); a label needs at least 200 freehold residential properties. No address or owner field is used anywhere in this file.

findings.en: The City of Cape Town holds 64.2% of the value on the province's valuation rolls.
The most valuable 10% of properties account for 46.9% of all roll value.
The least valuable half of properties together hold 10.1% of all roll value.
The median freehold home in the Western Cape is valued at R860,000.
28,407 properties are valued at R10 million or more.
Bantry Bay (City of Cape Town) has the highest median freehold home value, R26,500,000.
findings.label: Bantry Bay

queries.catmap: CREATE TEMP TABLE catmap AS SELECT c, t, <rule> AS rule FROM (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(category,'') c, COALESCE(tenure_type,'') t, UPPER(TRIM(text before '[' of category)) lbl FROM property); grp = rule, except fallback_farm -> agricultural and unmapped/reference -> other; rule = CASE WHEN k.lbl LIKE '%ROSS REF%' OR k.lbl LIKE 'REFER/%' THEN 'reference' WHEN k.lbl LIKE '%PSI%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%INFRASTRUCT%' OR k.lbl='RDST' OR k.lbl='PUBLIC ROAD' OR k.lbl LIKE '%IMPERMISSIBLE%' THEN 'public_infrastructure' WHEN k.lbl LIKE 'MUN%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%NICIPAL%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%ICIPAL PROP%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%IPAL PROP%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%STATE AND%' OR k.lbl='STATOW' OR k.lbl LIKE 'STATE%' OR k.lbl LIKE '% OF STATE%' OR k.lbl LIKE 'STATVC%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%PSP%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%PUBLIC SERVICE%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%PUBLIC PURPOSE%' THEN 'municipal_state' WHEN k.lbl LIKE '%AGR%' OR k.lbl LIKE 'FAR%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%FARM%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%ULTURAL%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%TURAL PROP%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%SMALLHOLD%' THEN 'agricultural' WHEN k.lbl LIKE '%VAC%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%LAND :%' THEN 'vacant' WHEN k.lbl LIKE '%MULTI%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%PBO%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%BENEFIT%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%WORSHIP%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%RELIG%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%CHURCH%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%CONSERV%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%PROTECT%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%NOT LIABLE%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%NOT FOR PROFIT%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%MONUMENT%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%SHELTER%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%MISC%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%OPEN SPACE%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%RESERVE%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%USE PROPERTY%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%RSHIP%' OR k.lbl IN ('WOR','REL','PROT','POS','PROS','PUBBNR','PRIVATE ROAD','PRIVATE ROADS') OR k.lbl LIKE 'POW%' THEN 'other' WHEN k.lbl LIKE '%INDUSTR%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%STRIAL PROP%' OR k.lbl IN ('IND','INDUS','SS IND') OR k.lbl LIKE 'IND %' OR k.lbl LIKE '%MINING%' OR k.lbl LIKE 'MINE%' OR k.lbl='MIN' THEN 'industrial' WHEN k.lbl LIKE '%BUS%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%COMMERC%' OR k.lbl IN ('COM','COMM') OR k.lbl LIKE 'COM %' OR k.lbl LIKE '%SHOP%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%OFFICE%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%RETAIL%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%GUEST%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%HOTEL%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%ACCOMMODATION%' THEN 'business_commercial' WHEN k.lbl LIKE '%RES%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%DENTIAL%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%NTIAL%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%DWELL%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%SECTIONAL%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%SEC SCHEME%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%FLAT%' OR k.lbl LIKE '%HOUSING%' THEN 'residential' WHEN k.t='farm' THEN 'fallback_farm' ELSE 'unmapped' END
queries.reliable_roll: match.db: SELECT roll_id FROM roll_unit WHERE unreliable=0 AND n>=30
queries.totals: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(market_value_r>0), SUM(CASE WHEN market_value_r>0 THEN market_value_r END), SUM(market_value_r=0), SUM(market_value_r IS NULL) FROM property
queries.coverage: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT municipality_id), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT municipality_id||'/'||roll_type), SUM(roll_type<>'GV') FROM roll
queries.sv_munis: SELECT DISTINCT m.name FROM roll r JOIN municipality m ON m.id=r.municipality_id WHERE r.roll_type<>'GV' ORDER BY 1
queries.rolls: SELECT m.name, m.district, MAX(r.cycle), COUNT(*) rows_, SUM(r.roll_type='GV'), SUM(r.roll_type<>'GV'), SUM(p.market_value_r=0), SUM(p.market_value_r IS NULL), SUM(p.market_value_r BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), SUM(cm.rule='unmapped'), 1.0*SUM(p.extent_m2>0)/COUNT(*) FROM property p CROSS JOIN roll r ON r.id=p.roll_id CROSS JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id CROSS JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') GROUP BY m.name, m.district
queries.reliable_by_muni: SELECT m.name, COUNT(rr.roll_id) FROM municipality m LEFT JOIN roll r ON r.municipality_id=m.id LEFT JOIN temp.reliable_roll rr ON rr.roll_id=r.id GROUP BY m.name
queries.land_ppm: SELECT m.name, MAX(n), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.25*n THEN x END), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.5*n THEN x END), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.75*n THEN x END) FROM (SELECT p.municipality_id mid, 1.0*p.market_value_r/p.extent_m2 x, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.municipality_id ORDER BY 1.0*p.market_value_r/p.extent_m2) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.municipality_id) n FROM property p JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') WHERE cm.grp='residential' AND (p.tenure_type='full_title' AND p.market_value_r>=10000 AND p.extent_m2 BETWEEN 20 AND 50000 AND p.roll_id IN (SELECT roll_id FROM temp.reliable_roll))) JOIN municipality m ON m.id=mid GROUP BY m.name
queries.land_erf: SELECT m.name, MAX(n), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.25*n THEN x END), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.5*n THEN x END), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.75*n THEN x END) FROM (SELECT p.municipality_id mid, p.extent_m2 x, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.municipality_id ORDER BY p.extent_m2) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.municipality_id) n FROM property p JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') WHERE cm.grp='residential' AND (p.tenure_type='full_title' AND p.market_value_r>=10000 AND p.extent_m2 BETWEEN 20 AND 50000 AND p.roll_id IN (SELECT roll_id FROM temp.reliable_roll))) JOIN municipality m ON m.id=mid GROUP BY m.name
queries.land_vacant_ppm: SELECT m.name, MAX(n), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.25*n THEN x END), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.5*n THEN x END), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.75*n THEN x END) FROM (SELECT p.municipality_id mid, 1.0*p.market_value_r/p.extent_m2 x, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.municipality_id ORDER BY 1.0*p.market_value_r/p.extent_m2) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.municipality_id) n FROM property p JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') WHERE cm.grp='vacant' AND (p.tenure_type='full_title' AND p.market_value_r>=10000 AND p.extent_m2 BETWEEN 20 AND 50000 AND p.roll_id IN (SELECT roll_id FROM temp.reliable_roll))) JOIN municipality m ON m.id=mid GROUP BY m.name
queries.pct_all: SELECT node, MAX(n) n, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.1*n THEN v END) p10, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.25*n THEN v END) p25, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.5*n THEN v END) p50, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.75*n THEN v END) p75, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.9*n THEN v END) p90, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.99*n THEN v END) p99 FROM (SELECT {node} node, p.market_value_r v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY {node} ORDER BY p.market_value_r) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY {node}) n FROM property p JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id  WHERE p.market_value_r>0) GROUP BY node
queries.pct_res_fh: SELECT node, MAX(n) n, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.1*n THEN v END) p10, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.25*n THEN v END) p25, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.5*n THEN v END) p50, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.75*n THEN v END) p75, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.9*n THEN v END) p90, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.99*n THEN v END) p99 FROM (SELECT {node} node, p.market_value_r v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY {node} ORDER BY p.market_value_r) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY {node}) n FROM property p JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') WHERE cm.grp='residential' AND COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') NOT IN ('sectional','sectional_parent') AND p.market_value_r>1000) GROUP BY node
queries.loghist: SELECT {node} node, CASE WHEN p.market_value_r<10000 THEN -1 WHEN p.market_value_r>=1e9 THEN 99 ELSE CAST(FLOOR(LOG10(p.market_value_r)*4) AS INT)-16 END bin, COUNT(*), SUM(p.market_value_r) FROM property p JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id WHERE p.market_value_r>0 GROUP BY 1,2
queries.groups_count: SELECT {node}, cm.grp, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN p.market_value_r>0 THEN p.market_value_r END) FROM property p JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') GROUP BY 1,2
queries.groups_median: SELECT node, grp, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.5*n THEN v END) FROM (SELECT {node} node, cm.grp grp, p.market_value_r v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY {node}, cm.grp ORDER BY p.market_value_r) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY {node}, cm.grp) n FROM property p JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') WHERE p.market_value_r>0) GROUP BY 1,2
queries.conc: SELECT node, COUNT(*) n, 2.0*SUM(rn*1.0*v)/(COUNT(*)*1.0*SUM(v))-(COUNT(*)+1.0)/COUNT(*) gini, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn>0.9*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) top10, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn>0.99*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) top1, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn>0.999*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) top01, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=0.5*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) bottom50 FROM (SELECT {node} node, p.market_value_r v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY {node} ORDER BY p.market_value_r) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY {node}) n FROM property p JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id  WHERE p.market_value_r>0) GROUP BY node
queries.conc_res: SELECT node, COUNT(*) n, 2.0*SUM(rn*1.0*v)/(COUNT(*)*1.0*SUM(v))-(COUNT(*)+1.0)/COUNT(*) gini, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn>0.9*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) top10, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn>0.99*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) top1, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn>0.999*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) top01, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=0.5*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) bottom50 FROM (SELECT {node} node, p.market_value_r v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY {node} ORDER BY p.market_value_r) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY {node}) n FROM property p JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') WHERE cm.grp='residential' AND p.market_value_r>0) GROUP BY node
queries.places: SELECT m.name, lbl, MAX(n) n, MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.5*n THEN v END) med FROM (SELECT p.municipality_id mid, UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.suburb),''), p.town))) lbl, p.market_value_r v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.municipality_id, UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.suburb),''), p.town))) ORDER BY p.market_value_r) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.municipality_id, UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.suburb),''), p.town)))) n FROM property p JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') WHERE cm.grp='residential' AND COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') NOT IN ('sectional','sectional_parent') AND p.market_value_r>1000 AND NOT ((p.municipality_id=(SELECT id FROM municipality WHERE name='City of Cape Town') AND COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'')='full_title' AND p.erf_no IS NULL) OR (p.municipality_id=(SELECT id FROM municipality WHERE name='City of Cape Town') AND p.erf_no IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(p.suburb,'') LIKE '%HOLDING%' OR COALESCE(p.suburb,'') LIKE '%SEE BELOW%' OR COALESCE(p.suburb,'') LIKE '%SEE HANGING%' OR COALESCE(p.category,'') LIKE 'MULTIPLE PURPOSE%'))) AND NOT (p.municipality_id=(SELECT id FROM municipality WHERE name='Matzikama') AND COALESCE(TRIM(p.suburb),'')='0')) JOIN municipality m ON m.id=mid WHERE lbl IS NOT NULL AND lbl<>'' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING MAX(n)>=200 ORDER BY med DESC, n DESC
queries.f_ct_share: SELECT 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN m.name='City of Cape Town' THEN p.market_value_r END)/SUM(p.market_value_r) FROM property p JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id WHERE p.market_value_r>0 AND NOT (p.municipality_id=(SELECT id FROM municipality WHERE name='City of Cape Town') AND COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'')='full_title' AND p.erf_no IS NULL)
queries.f_concentration: SELECT node, COUNT(*) n, 2.0*SUM(rn*1.0*v)/(COUNT(*)*1.0*SUM(v))-(COUNT(*)+1.0)/COUNT(*) gini, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn>0.9*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) top10, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn>0.99*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) top1, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn>0.999*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) top01, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=0.5*n THEN v END)/SUM(v) bottom50 FROM (SELECT {node} node, p.market_value_r v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY {node} ORDER BY p.market_value_r) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY {node}) n FROM property p JOIN municipality m ON m.id=p.municipality_id  WHERE p.market_value_r>0 AND NOT (p.municipality_id=(SELECT id FROM municipality WHERE name='City of Cape Town') AND COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'')='full_title' AND p.erf_no IS NULL)) GROUP BY node
queries.f_res_fh_median: SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(CASE WHEN rn>=0.5*n THEN v END) FROM (SELECT p.market_value_r v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.market_value_r) rn, COUNT(*) OVER () n FROM property p JOIN temp.catmap cm ON cm.c=COALESCE(p.category,'') AND cm.t=COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') WHERE cm.grp='residential' AND COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'') NOT IN ('sectional','sectional_parent') AND p.market_value_r>1000 AND NOT ((p.municipality_id=(SELECT id FROM municipality WHERE name='City of Cape Town') AND COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'')='full_title' AND p.erf_no IS NULL) OR (p.municipality_id=(SELECT id FROM municipality WHERE name='City of Cape Town') AND p.erf_no IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(p.suburb,'') LIKE '%HOLDING%' OR COALESCE(p.suburb,'') LIKE '%SEE BELOW%' OR COALESCE(p.suburb,'') LIKE '%SEE HANGING%' OR COALESCE(p.category,'') LIKE 'MULTIPLE PURPOSE%'))))
queries.f_over_10m: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property p WHERE p.market_value_r>=10000000 AND NOT (p.municipality_id=(SELECT id FROM municipality WHERE name='City of Cape Town') AND COALESCE(p.tenure_type,'')='full_title' AND p.erf_no IS NULL)
